Our incredible 2021 RAM 1500 TRX Crew Cab 4X4 with the Level 2 Package is a burly machine that's ready to roar in Granite Crystal Metallic w/Diamond Black Crystal Pearl Two Tone! Motivated by a SuperCharged 6.2 Liter HEMI V8 delivering 702hp to an 8 Speed Automatic transmission to rocket to 60mph in just 4.5 seconds. This Four Wheel Drive truck also features exclusive Bilstein shocks, a solid Dana 60 rear axle, a fully independent front suspension with active dampers, and a full-time active transfer case to excel in the most punishing off-road conditions. Our 1500 TRX looks the part, with a bold hood scoop, a mighty RAM grille with flow-through lettering, LED lighting, RamBar, off-road style running boards, a 2.6-inch Eibach Performance Coilover Spring Lift with 1.5-inch Rear Replacement Springs and Four Wheel Alignment, 20-inch Vossen Forged HF64 Gloss Black Wheels, 37X12.50R20 Nitto Ridge Grappler Tires, Professionally Installed Window Tint w/Lifetime Warranty, and a spray-on bedliner has been applied as well.

Look up at that panoramic sunroof. To master your day with digital ease, there's a massive 12-inch touchscreen, full-color navigation, WiFi compatibility, Android Auto, Apple CarPlay, Bluetooth, 19-speaker Harman Kardon audio, and a surround-view camera system!

RAM is built on a high-strength steel frame with safety technologies such as automatic braking, parking sensors, hill-start assist, tire-pressure monitoring, and trailer-sway control. With all that and more, our 1500 TRX is the T. Rex of trucks! Save this Page and Call for Availability. We Know You Will Enjoy Your Lifted Trucks Nashville Test Drive Towards Ownership! Our inventory is nationally sourced by our certified buyers who cherry pick only the best of the best of what is available. These vehicles then go through an 82 point inspection process to guarantee quality and safety. Our lift kits are installed by our own factory-trained technicians, who have thousands of hours of experience. The installation is then inspected by a second dedicated quality control technician, before being sent to our state of the art Hunter Engineering laser alignment rack. Our aftermarket research and development team always matches the best fitting lift kit, shocks, and wheel & tire combinations to each individual vehicle for optimal off-road performance, while maintaining an incredibly smooth ride on the street. We never cut any corners on our builds, which is why we only use top quality name brand products when building your Truck, SUV or Jeep. Lifted Trucks has thousands of 5-star reviews, and one of the highest rates of repeat customers in the auto industry. Stop by today, and experience the difference.

description: The 2024 Chevrolet Silverado 1500 High Country in Sterling Gray Metallic is the definition of a "no-compromise" truck. It blends rugged 4WD capability with the kind of luxury you'd usually expect from a high-end sedan. This specific model is a CARFAX One-Owner with a Clean CARFAX, meaning its been well-loved and is ready to hit the road for its next chapter. The perforated leather seats are both heated and ventilated in the front, and even the rear passengers get heated outboard seats. Real wood accents on the console, dashboard, and doors give the interior a sophisticated feel, while the 12.3" digital display and premium Chevrolet Infotainment system keep all your tech front and center. Plus, the power sunroof lets in plenty of natural light, making every drive feel a bit more open and airy.Safety and convenience are baked into every corner of this High Country. With Adaptive Cruise Control, Lane Keep Assist, and HD Surround Vision, you'll feel confident navigating busy streets or tight parking spots. If you're planning on towing, this truck makes it easy with an Integrated Trailer Brake Controller and Hitch Guidance with Hitch View. The Multi-Flex Tailgate and spray-on bedliner add a layer of practicality that proves this truck is just as ready for work as it is for a night out.On the outside, this Silverado makes a bold statement with 22" painted aluminum wheels and chrome assist steps. The Sterling Gray Metallic paint looks sharp against the body-color mirror caps and dual exhaust with polished outlets. Features like rain-sensing wipers and IntelliBeam automatic high beams take the guesswork out of driving in changing weather, so you can focus on the journey ahead. Its a truck that looks just as good parked in the driveway as it does pulling a trailer.This Silverado High Country is the perfect balance of grit and glamour. It offers a "best-of-all-worlds" experience for anyone who needs a reliable workhorse but doesn't want to sacrifice the finer things in life. From the heated steering wheel to the advanced safety alerts, every detail has been thought out to make your time behind the wheel as enjoyable as possible.Faster. Simpler. More Transparent. Safety and technology are also top priorities, with features like the BLIS with Cross-Traffic Alert, Automatic High Beam, and the advanced SYNC 4 infotainment system with Enhanced Voice Recognition. The B&O Sound System by Bang & Olufsen will elevate your listening experience, while the Heavy-Service Front Suspension Package ensures your truck can handle even the toughest loads.

Whether you're a contractor, outdoor enthusiast, or simply in need of a capable and well-equipped truck, the 2024 Ford F-250SD XLT is the perfect choice. Experience the power, versatility, and premium features that make this truck a true standout in its class. Visit our showroom today to take it for a test drive and discover why the F-250SD is the ultimate work and play companion.

Convenience
  • Unresponsive driver assistant - a reaction to inaction. Maybe you fell asleep. Maybe you lost consciousness. No matter how it happens, Unresponsive driver assistant works to help lessen the danger when it does. It detects prolonged driver unresponsiveness, automatically bringing the vehicle to a stop and turning on the hazard lights. If equipped, emergency services will also be contacted. Unresponsive driver assistant is safety that never sleeps.
Safety and Security
  • Hands-off cruise control with lane change - Set it and forget it. Road trips used to be stressful. Cruise control only managed speed, but not distance or safety. Now with hands-off cruise control with lane change simply set your desired speed and let sensor technology maintain a safe distance between you and surrounding vehicles with minimal steering input from you. It slows you down, speeds you up, and helps you make lane changes. Meet your ultimate co-pilot with hands-off cruise control with lane change.
  • Forward collision mitigation - Forward thinking. You look away for just a second and suddenly the vehicle in front of you has stopped. That's when the forward collision mitigation system comes to life. When it senses an impending impact, it will activate a combination of features to help prevent or reduce the severity of an accident. Forward collision mitigation is always looking ahead.
  • Pedestrian impact prevention - An extra step toward safety. Pedestrians don't always stop, look, and listen, but with Pedestrian Impact Prevention, your vehicle is equipped to better see them and avoid them. This system constantly monitors the road ahead to identify and track pedestrians. It projects that image to an interior display screen, AND should an impact become likely, Pedestrian impact prevention takes steps to avoid a collision.

Elevate Your Drive with the 2024 Chevrolet Silverado 1500 LTZ

Experience the pinnacle of power and versatility with the 2024 Chevrolet Silverado 1500 LTZ. This exceptional full-size pickup boasts a commanding presence and a feature-rich interior that will elevate your driving experience to new heights.

- Z71 OFF-ROAD AND PROTECTION PACKAGE
- LTZ CONVENIENCE PACKAGE II
- Iridescent Pearl Tricoat
- Multi-Flex Tailgate
- 12.3" Multicolor Reconfigurable Digital Display
- Ventilated Driver & Front Passenger Seats
- Adaptive Cruise Control
- Rear Pedestrian Alert
- Wireless Charging

Beneath the bold exterior, the Silverado 1500 LTZ is powered by a potent EcoTec3 5.3L V8 engine mated to a smooth-shifting 10-speed automatic transmission and 4-wheel drive. This powertrain delivers a confident and responsive driving experience, while also providing impressive fuel efficiency with an EPA-estimated 15 city/20 highway MPG.

Designed to tackle any terrain, the Silverado 1500 LTZ is equipped with the Z71 Off-Road and Protection Package, featuring an off-road-tuned suspension, skid plates, and all-terrain tires. Whether you're navigating rugged trails or hauling heavy loads, this truck is built to handle it all with ease.

Step inside the spacious cabin and you'll be surrounded by premium amenities that cater to your every need. Enjoy the comfort of heated and ventilated front seats, a heated steering wheel, and a Bose premium audio system that delivers a truly immersive listening experience. The Chevrolet Infotainment 3 Premium system with a 12.3-inch reconfigurable digital display puts a wealth of connectivity and information at your fingertips.

Safety is also a top priority in the Silverado 1500 LTZ, with features like Forward Collision Alert, Automatic Emergency Braking, and Rear Pedestrian Alert, providing you and your passengers with added peace of mind on the road.

This 2024 Chevrolet Silverado 1500 LTZ is the perfect blend of power, capability, and refinement. Experience the difference for yourself and schedule a test drive today. We're confident that once you get behind the wheel, you'll be captivated by its exceptional performance and uncompromising quality.

Finished in striking Antimatter Blue Metallic with a black leather interior, this Raptor is built for drivers in Port Orchard, Bremerton, Silverdale, and across Kitsap County who want serious capability without sacrificing technology and comfort.

Performance and Capability

• High Output 3.5L EcoBoost V6 delivering exceptional horsepower and torque

Comfort and Technology

Recent Maintenance

• Oil and filter change
• Air filter replaced

Yes. The SuperCrew cab, leather interior, and advanced technology make it comfortable for commuting while still delivering serious off-road capability.

How capable is the 2022 Raptor off road?
With FOX Live Valve suspension, locking differentials, skid plates, and multiple terrain modes, the Raptor is engineered for extreme off-road performance.

Why are Raptors so popular in the Pacific Northwest?
Their ability to handle trails, snow, towing, and everyday driving makes them a favorite among truck buyers across Port Orchard, Bremerton, and Kitsap County.
